articles.title: Zscaler Agentic SOC combines AI agents with zero trust telemetry
articles.summary: Zscaler has announced Zscaler Agentic SOC, a new approach to security operations built to proactively reduce exposures, scale human expertise and stop AI-driven attacks at machine speed. Simply layering in AI capabilities onto the existing security stack will not provide the protection needed.
